images.title: The chapter in three pictures
images.purpose: Give the revision a map: reflection symmetry (a letter with a dashed line), rotational symmetry (a pinwheel with a turn arrow) and both (a letter with dashed lines and a turn arrow).
images.composition: Three cards in a row, each with one picture and a caption under it.
images.exact_structure: Plain white frame, 1456 by 816. Three cards in one row. Each card is a rounded rectangle 380 wide and 440 tall with a thin dark #2B2B2B outline and a white fill, at x 80 to 460, 538 to 918 and 996 to 1376, all at y 130 to 570. CARD 1: the capital letter A in plain sans-serif, teal #0072B2, 280 px tall, centred, with one dashed vertical line in grey #6B7280 (5 px dashes) down its exact middle at x 270 from y 150 to y 550. CARD 2: a pinwheel of exactly 4 identical teal #0072B2 triangular blades, each blade a triangle whose point is at the centre pin and whose flat side faces outward, one blade pointing up, one right, one down and one left, about 240 px across, centred, with a small dark circle (20 px) at the centre; around it one curved arrow in reddish purple #CC79A7 going a quarter of the way round, 8 px thick. CARD 3: the capital letter H in plain sans-serif, teal #0072B2, 280 px tall, centred, with one dashed vertical line and one dashed horizontal line in grey #6B7280 through its exact middle, and one curved arrow in reddish purple #CC79A7 going half way round at the top right of the card. Under the cards, centred on each card at y 640, a caption in dark #1F2937 sans-serif (40 px): Reflection symmetry, Rotational symmetry, Both. Exactly 3 pictures, 3 dashed lines in all, 2 curved arrows and 3 captions. Nothing else in the frame.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
any text other than the three captions
images.takeaway: A fold line tests reflection symmetry, a turn tests rotational symmetry, and a shape can have both.
images.description: Three cards: the letter A with a dashed vertical line, a pinwheel with a turning arrow, and the letter H with dashed lines and a turning arrow.
images.context: Summary map for the Chapter Revision. It uses the plan's own pictures, one for each kind of symmetry of the chapter.
images.teaching_notes: Use it to connect the chapter's ideas in one look: fold for lines, turn for rotation, and the letter H passes both tests.

image_decisions.why: A map of the three kinds of symmetry (a line, a turn, both) helps the revision connect the whole chapter.
